item.title: A Brand New Day for Santasiero’s Brings Good Fortune for the West Side
item.description: A new ownership group has opted to purchase one of Buffalo’s most beloved Italian restaurants. Mark Longo and Jennifer Hurley – both attorneys – along with home builder David Capretto, have stepped up to save the West Side landmark, Santasiero’s. Currently, the building is under contract, with closing anticipated this coming Monday. That same day, work on refreshing the interior will commence. item.title: Seneca Buffalo Creek Casino’s 2026 Outer Harbor Live Concert and Event Series
item.description: Seneca Buffalo Creek Casino’s 2026 Outer Harbor live concert series will, once again, take place at Terminal B. After last year’s roaring concert successes, music lovers are already anticipating another rocking good time at the Outer Harbor. This year’s line-up is already shaping up, with Cake launching the season opener. item.title: ASI’s 2026 Fiscally Sponsored NYSCA Grantees
item.description: As arts funding gets cut across the country, we are excited to congratulate the 28 fiscally sponsored artists and organizations that received a $10,000 grant from the New York State Council on the Arts (NYSCA) for fiscal year 2026 through ASI. These grants will fund various artistic projects to be completed in 2026 across New York State. item.title: Completion of a New $6 million Visitor Center at the Frank Lloyd Wright-Designed Graycliff Estate
item.description: Governor Kathy Hochul has announced the completion of a new $6 million visitor center at the Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Graycliff estate in Derby. The 4,400-square-foot facility is intended to provide year-round programming, events, and amenities, in tandem with the recently renovated historic home and grounds.
